items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from one month old and upward, and to record their names
items.action: said unto; commanded to number and record
items.object: the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel; their names
